first.why: 'a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him ... having his Father's name': the Lamb of 5:6-9 and 12:10-11, who is Jesus Christ (1:5); his Father is named here.

second.why: 'a Lamb stood on the mount Sion... having his Father's name' is the Lamb of Revelation, whose blood redeems (5:9) as Jesus Christ's does (1:5); him and his follow it.

first.why: 'in the presence of the Lamb': the same Lamb as 14:1,4, slain and redeeming (5:9), who is Jesus Christ (1:5).

second.why: 'in the presence of the Lamb' names the Lamb, the title Revelation gives the one who redeemed by his blood (5:9), as Jesus Christ did (1:5).

first.why: 'the song of the Lamb' set beside the song of Moses: the Lamb of the book is Jesus Christ, the slain redeemer (5:9, 1:5).

second.why: 'the song of the Lamb' names the Lamb, Revelation's title for the one redeeming by his blood (5:9, cf. Jesus Christ in 1:5); 'Lord God Almighty' addressed after is God.

first.why: 'the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings'; the Lamb is the slain one (5:9), i.e. Jesus Christ (1:5), who is also 'King of kings' in 19:16.

second.why: 'make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords' is the Lamb of Revelation, whose blood redeems (5:9) as Jesus Christ's does (1:5).

first.why: 'the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife': the Lamb is the slain one of 5:6-9, Jesus Christ (1:5); the same Lamb is meant in 21:9 'the Lamb's wife'.

second.why: 'the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife' names the Lamb, Revelation's title for the redeemer by blood (5:9, 1:5 Jesus Christ); 'give honour to him' is God of 19:6.

first.why: 'the marriage supper of the Lamb': the Lamb is the slain redeemer of 5:9, Jesus Christ (1:5), whose marriage is announced in 19:7.

second.why: 'the marriage supper of the Lamb' names the Lamb, Revelation's title for the one who redeemed by his blood (5:9), as Jesus Christ did (1:5).

first.why: 'he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True': the rider's titles fit Jesus Christ 'the faithful witness' (1:5, 3:14), and he is King of kings and Lord of lords (19:16) as the Lamb is (17:14).

second.why: The rider 'called Faithful and True' bears 'KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS' (19:16), the Lamb's title in 17:14, and matches 'Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness' (1:5, 3:14).

first.why: 'his name is called The Word of God' names the rider of 19:11, who is King of kings and Lord of lords (19:16) like the Lamb (17:14), Jesus Christ; his 'vesture dipped in blood' fits the Lamb's blood.

second.why: 'his name is called The Word of God' names the rider of 19:11, who bears the Lamb's title 'KING OF KINGS' (19:16, 17:14) and is 'Faithful and True' as Jesus Christ is 'the faithful witness' (1:5).

first.why: 'the bride, the Lamb's wife': the Lamb is the slain Lamb of 5:6-9 and 19:7, Jesus Christ (1:5).

second.why: 'the bride, the Lamb's wife' names the Lamb, Revelation's title for the one who redeemed by his blood (5:9), as Jesus Christ did (1:5).

first.why: 'the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel': the nation, by its tribes, on the gates.

second.why: 'the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel': the nation's tribes written on the gates.

first.why: 'the twelve apostles of the Lamb': the Lamb is the slain Lamb of 5:6-9, Jesus Christ (1:5), whose sent ones are apostles.

second.why: 'the twelve apostles of the Lamb' names the Lamb, Revelation's title for the one who redeemed by his blood (5:9), as Jesus Christ did (1:5).

first.why: 'the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it': the Lamb is the slain one of 5:6-9, Jesus Christ (1:5), named beside God.

second.why: 'the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it' names the Lamb beside God, Revelation's title for the redeemer by blood (5:9), as Jesus Christ is (1:5).

first.why: 'the Lamb is the light thereof': the Lamb, distinct from God whose glory lightens the city, is the slain Lamb of 5:6-9, Jesus Christ (1:5).

second.why: 'the Lamb is the light thereof' names the Lamb, Revelation's title for the one who redeemed by his blood (5:9), as Jesus Christ did (1:5).

first.why: 'the Lamb's book of life': the Lamb of 13:8 and 21:9, the slain Lamb of 5:9, is Jesus Christ (1:5).

second.why: 'the Lamb's book of life' names the Lamb, Revelation's title for the one who redeemed by his blood (5:9), as Jesus Christ did (1:5).

first.why: 'the throne of God and of the Lamb': the Lamb beside God on the throne (cf. 5:6,13) is the slain Lamb, Jesus Christ (1:5).

second.why: 'the throne of God and of the Lamb' names the Lamb, Revelation's title for the one who redeemed by his blood (5:9), as Jesus Christ did (1:5).

first.why: 'the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it': the Lamb is the slain Lamb of 5:6-9, Jesus Christ (1:5).

second.why: 'the throne of God and of the Lamb' names the Lamb; 'his servants shall serve him' may be God or the Lamb, so only 'the Lamb' is given.

first.why: 'I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last' follows 'behold, I come quickly' (22:12) and leads to 'I Jesus' (22:16), and 1:17-18 gives 'the first and the last' to the one who was dead; yet 1:8, 21:6 give 'Alpha and Omega' to God.

second.why: The speaker continues 22:12 'I come quickly', whom 22:16 'I Jesus' and 22:20 'Surely I come quickly... come, Lord Jesus' identify; yet 1:8 gives 'Alpha and Omega' to the Lord God.

settled: Kept, of the verse only: the speaker of 'I come quickly' (22:12) says 'I Jesus have sent mine angel' (22:16) and 'Surely I come quickly' (22:20).
